task_message:
Case M26: segment the myxoid soft-tissue tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 261x261x510 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Done. 

**Result:** A single well-circumscribed, T2-hyperintense myxoid soft-tissue tumor in the anterolateral subcutaneous/intramuscular compartment of the right thigh was segmented (106.4 mL, one connected component, axial extent k = 267–386, i.e. ~12 cm cranio-caudal).

**How it went:**
1. Located the lesion on axial/coronal/sagittal sheets — a bright ovoid mass seen on axial slices ~283–370 and spanning coronal slices j ≈ 122–153.
2. Started the mask with three positive points placed inside the mass (marks 892/870/835) on axial 317; the model returned a clean single-component 3D mask.
3. Verified the boundary in all three planes at high zoom (coronal 112/132/150, sagittal 184, axial 272/340/380) — the green outline tracked the lesion edge; axial 272 and 380 confirmed the tapered poles.
4. Automatic candidates found no missed lesion tissue.
5. Final five-slice-per-plane review showed no lesion in any past-the-end panel and no normal tissue included, so the mask was saved with **high** confidence.
